rationale: Equal-area criterion for SMIB: delta0=asin(Pm/prefault_pmax)=asin(0.9/2.0)=26.7437 deg; delta_max=pi-asin(Pm/postfault_pmax)=pi-asin(0.9/1.5)=143.1301 deg; cos(delta_cr)=(Pm*(delta_max-delta0)+postfault_pmax*cos(delta_max))/postfault_pmax gives delta_cr=65.2414 deg; t_cr=sqrt(4*H*(delta_cr-delta0)/(2*pi*f0*Pm))=0.19499 s.
